notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam: Technical Playtest Begins Now!
notes.content:
We're kicking off our technical playtest today, May 23 – a bit differently than planned.

[previewyoutube=OeL0vvx32zQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Due to a pending approval for the dedicated Playtest App, we've decided to launch the Steam Demo version early instead. This version will be updated continuously based on your feedback and will remain available for about one month, including during Steam Next Fest.

What's in the demo?
You'll experience a slice of a campaign mission with multiple replayable routes. Each run takes between 30 and 60 minutes. Weapons can be ranked up, and attachments unlocked.

What we're looking for:

 How well does it run on your system?
 Did you encounter any critical bugs or crashes?
 Are there design elements you’d like to see improved?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/4b37ec36792022fa2d73018e6eaae9840337a769.jpg

⚠️ This is a work-in-progress. Expect bugs, placeholder content, and unfinished systems. Your input will directly shape how the game evolves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/09c9c962a47625315bd933e566b6c10ee0809d63.jpg

🐛 Known & Expected Bugs
As this is an early work-in-progress build, some issues are known and currently being addressed:


 Unresponsive AI Behavior
Enemy AI may occasionally fail to react properly. This is often caused by missing information nodes or the inability to find valid cover. We're actively adjusting these systems to strike the right balance between performance and intelligent behavior.

 Weapon Rank Display Bug
In some cases, the in-game weapon rank may appear to reset or decrease after restarting a mission. This is purely a visual issue — your actual progress and weapon stats remain unaffected.

 Audio Mixing Incomplete
The overall sound mix is still under development. Expect placeholder audio, inconsistent volume levels, and general imbalance. This is a key area we’ll be improving over the coming weeks.

 Gameplay Lag Spikes
You may experience minor stutters or lag spikes, particularly when loading new sections of the level. We’re aware of this and working on smoother level streaming and performance optimizations.


Please continue to share your experiences — your feedback is critical as we refine the game.

📥 Download the demo now from the Steam Store page.

Wishlist Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/

notes.title: Win Steam Credits by Reviewing Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Enhanced Edition
notes.content:
Polygon Art is thrilled to announce an exciting special event for Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Enhanced Edition on Steam. 

In an effort to engage with the gaming community and gather valuable player feedback, the game will be offered at a significant 80% discount starting from February 15, 2024, at 07:00 PM CET, lasting for a duration of 4 days.

During this promotional period, players are encouraged to dive into the action-packed world of Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Enhanced Edition and share their experiences by submitting reviews on Steam. To make the event more enticing, only reviews that reflect a gameplay time of 120 minutes (2 hours) or more at the time of review submission will be considered valid for this special event. It's important to note that the event aims to foster a constructive and respectful community; therefore, reviews that are toxic, insulting, or contain promotional content for other games or services will not be eligible.

The window for review submissions is open until February 23, 2024, at 01:00 PM CET. Following the closure of the submission period, three lucky winners will be chosen at random from the pool of valid reviews. The announcement of the winners will be made on both Steam and various social media platforms, ensuring that the community is kept in the loop.

Winners will have the unique opportunity to claim 10€ in Steam Gift Card, adding an extra layer of excitement to the event. To secure their prize, winners must contact Polygon Art by the deadline of February 26, 2024, at 01:00 PM CET.

This event not only offers players a fantastic opportunity to experience Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Enhanced Edition at a steep discount but also allows them to contribute to the game's community by sharing their honest opinions and insights. Polygon Art looks forward to the community's participation and is excited to hear what players have to say about their gaming experience.

notes.title: The future of United Assault, Beyond Enemy Lines and survey evaluation
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is the day we look into the future of United Assault, Beyond Enemy Lines and evaluate the latest 'Next Game' survey. There is a lot of new stuff coming in 2022 to play. Lets get started!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/c5101b517df9d38ab2768fdeb42f05a1d48b1c11.png

United Assault - Normandy'44 is a massive success for Polygon Art and the quickest selling game we ever build! I have big planes for United assault and here is what's coming next:

I'm very Happy to announce:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/2f3fc03bb5404f14332e455c98b4db2c0d5a595a.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625340/United_Assault__Battle_of_the_Bulge/

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/2e1034806bc63a5d27dcdf98b543c419a5f681d5.png
Click for full screen view

United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is a standalone expansion to United Assault - Normandy'44 and an open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of Ardennes.

As a british paratromy you are assigned to a mission, few would qualify for. You are tasked to infiltrate enemy territory and locate, infiltrate and destroy one of germany's secret V2 factories in the Ardennes. You'll come along heavy enemy resistance, try to weaken their defense by destroying their tanks, equipment and by gathering secret documents.

[previewyoutube=S_a8nc8H4cY;full][/previewyoutube]

ADD UNITED ASSAULT - BATTLE OF THE BULGE TO YOUR WISHLIST!

What is new?

 Playing as a british paratrooper and deploying on a parachute into the game.
 Authentic british World War 2 weapons
 Larger and more detailed towns and cities
 Drivable vehicles scattered around the gameworld
 The story is now directly integrated into the main gamemode
 Procedural generated underground bunkers complexes (like dungeons)

What does this mean for United Assault - Normandy'44?
More updates, features and improvements! I'm not going to abandon United Assault - Normandy'44!
Both games are build with the same code base and allows me to patch new features and improvements from Battle of the Bulge back into Normandy '44. All gameplay, gunplay and AI improvements will find it's way into Normandy'44 as well as several new weapons! If you don't want Battle of the Bulge, you still benefit from its development and get regular news updates.

Looking even more into the future?
I plann to expand United Assault with 2 additional standalone expansions in the same form as Battle of the Bulge. Those are:

Beyond Enemy Lines is returning in 2022 with a major update to Beyond Enemy Lines 2 and an entirly new game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/584c45f38fd991d528811c488f36cc7c9fe7d853.png

Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is getting a free update to a Enhanced Edition!

This update will bring new content, improved game- and gunplay, enhanced visuals and major performance improvements. The before canceled DLC Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Origins will be added for free to the game.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/a4ddd5b37e76e9f9e94ee85fe87e58beacd3412c.png
Click for full screen view

Features:

 The price will increase from 24.99€ to 29.99€ to get in line with the Console versions

The Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Enhanced Edition will be released early 2022 for free to all owners of the game on PC and Xbox One with additional native Xbox Series S|X support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/6966d5659cc0311781b25c7c344be9a592db23cf.png

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is the newest entry in the Beyond Enemy Lines franchise hitting Steam Early Access in Summer 2022!

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is a modern warfare shooter set in the Quang-Xiong Island, an autonomous island in the east chinese sea.
The island is of great military importance and the source of numerous conflicts. Whoever hasmilitary control over this territory, is in close range to attack china, taiwan, japan, as well as south and north korea.

Satellite intel reports a lot of recent activity on this island and satellite fotos indicate chinese forces occupied the island. China denies this information and confirms that it has not sent any troops to the region. We cannot verify the credibility of the statement, nor can we verify the identity of the occupiers.

We need to get to the bottom of this mess. You need to be careful - we don’t want a major international incident out of this.

Features:

 Powered by Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen Global Illumination and Reflections
 Command your own Squad
 Modern arsenal of highly detailed weapons
 Large, complex missions with full tactical freedom
 Mid mission checkpoints

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is smaller game in scope then Beyond Enemy Lines 2. We target a story set on 3-4 Missions, each lasting for ~60 minutes. We want to test out new stuff with this game, like a own AI controlled squad you can gve orders to and dip our toe into releasing a game with a new Engine - Unreal Engine 5. Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is building the foundation for Beyond Enemy Lines 3 ...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png



The Next Game Survey
I asked on Social Media, Steam and other platforms what you want to see in the future. Here is the evaluation of this survey with 983 participants at the time of evaluation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/a55a14097947f434cbdb08bf9519e1938dcf885a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/3b9c88bc125a152404dd5c824fb9b1d5f9020c6b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/73241b9e800edc4dcc436a2e0d78879e236e4bea.png
Click for full screen view

The majority of you (60%) want to see a new Singleplayer game developed. The diversity in genres you want to see us develop was a majot supprise. FPS games are by far (35%) the most requested games, as we develop mostly FPS games this is no big surprise. Followed by this are Simulation (14%) and Role Playing (13%) and Third Person Shooter and Action Adventire (12%).

Beyond Enemy Lines - The Role Playing experience? How would this sound to you? We will continue to focus on FPS games but will definitly consider developing smaller games in the other genres in the future.

We also asked which game you would like to see next. 35% of you want to see a new franchise, 28% a new Beyond Enemy Lines and as United Assault is still a very fresh game it already gathered a respectful 23%.  As both Beyond Enemy Lines and United Assault got new content and games revealed in this news, let's jump to the new franchise ...

The new franchise

We asked for suggestions which game you would like to see. And apparently you have a very clear goal in mind for us. You want to see from us in the future:

A Singleplayer FPS with focus on Story, more linear gameplay with occasionally larger areas with more freedom. The games you mentioned where shocklingly simmilar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/a9576a3afae61bffbde29c63d3713909bed5b128.png
You frequently Menitioned Golden Eye and other 007 games as well as No One Lives Forever.

We will follow your wishes and start concepting a new James Bond/No One Lives Forever like franchise together with you in 2022. More on this will follow next year!

notes.title: Update v31125 - DLSS 2.0 now available
notes.content:
Agents,

a new update for Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is available. This 'small' update enabled Nvidia DLSS 2.0 features for users of Nvidia Cards. You can find the options in the Video Settings.

While this update is around 1,9gb in size for just DLSS, I want to give you a short glimps of whats going on and why it's nearly 2GB in size.

I'm currently reorganizing the entire Asset pool. I will today start and try to merge Maps with it's improvements of the Xbox One version into the PC. This step needes some rearangement of assets.

Why I'm doing this? Due to the porting process to consoles last year, each Platform has a seperate source branch with it's unique changes. This makes updating and maintaining the game nearly impossible. I will update the PC version with all Console improvements and go even further with the PC version. After this the new PC version will be brought to Xbox One and maybe Playstation 4 (the PS4 patch process is stupidly complex and fails 9 out of 10 times).

Changelog:

 enabled Nvidia DLSS 2.0

notes.title: Update released: RTX and volumetric clouds
notes.content:
Agents,

a new Update for Beyond Enemy Lines 2 PC is now available! This new update is the first of many upcoming updates with the goal to revamp and improve the game. In this ongoing progress, we will try to fix remaining bugs, improve the gameplay and maybe even add new content. This is the very first update to lay the fundation of those changes. We upgraded from Unreal Engine 4.22 to 4.26 and with this needed to rework several parts of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829296/f7eb6bbf0b6147d96d915aa76fa5b2138c94d8bf.jpg

Changelog v31100

 update to Unreal Engine 4.26
 added early alpha version of RTX support (requires game to start in DX12 mode)*
 cleaned and streamlined asset pool, reduzed file size from 38gb to 20gb
 added more localization options
 added volumetric clouds
 reworked post processing, sky and lights across all missions
 massivly improved driving physics
 various smaller bug fixes


*RTX Support is realy an Alpha feature, maps are currently not optimized for RTX and Materials need addtional overhaul. We want to gather feedback on performance and will tweak the game step by step with upcoming updates. RTX is something new to us and we need to learn to master it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829296/1e274824f0214a696950465dcd258804f1378ae6.jpg

What's coming next?
We want to clean the code step by step and polish and streamline the player interactions and gunplay. We learned a lot sinze the development start of Beyond Enemy Lines 2 in 2017 and want to apply it to the game. This takes time and won't be completed within a week.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829296/e2315a251d1dc3048f16ce4fc7771abbf2b4ce69.jpg

So when can we expect the next update?
When it's done. We are focusing on a new project and updating the PC version of Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is a pure passion project which is done next to the new project. This unfurtunatly is the case as developing for PC is currently no viable option due to the bad marked conditions on Steam and we are not expecting to generate many sales with or without updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829296/28f666ed4d20a4213c66aa42b2a92da975dc1c85.jpg

Whats about Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Online?
In the progress of updating the engine, we needed to break the multiplayer part of Beyond Enemy Lines 2 as several used plugins dropped support and do no longer operate with the newest version of Unreal Engine 4. We are looking into fixing the new issues and get it interally running again. If we can achieve this in a reasonable time, BEL2 Online will get the same visual updates and possible gameplay and content updates again.

notes.title: v30610 - Startup Hotfix
notes.content:
A hotfix adressing the startup crash is now available!

Some of you experienced a crash on the games startup sequence. This error does only appear on a few systems and non of the development or QA systems where affected by this. But thanks to the awesome community we have a fix/workaround.

With the update of the Engine from 4.21 to 4.23 some time ago several core components of the game have changed. One of them was they key rebinding. Previously a Plugin was used to rebind keys which nolonger worked in Unreal Engine 4.23 and made the change the default Unreal Engine 4 key rebinding necessary. And this is what caused the issues.

For now it's not entirly clear which part of the key rebinding caused the issues (maybe an old config file interfering with the new system). Due to this key rebinding is currently unavailable to give me more time to investigate but restores the playability of the game for everyone.

Should you still have issues, please report the down below. Key Rebinding will be back as soon as possible!

Changelog:

 fixed startup crash
 temporarly removed key rebinding

notes.title: Server, Security and Anti-Cheat
notes.content:
Dedicated Server
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will launch with a Multiplayer and so servers are a big topic. You want a quick match with a friend? Just host a Peer-2-Peer (P2P) session from ingame and your friends can join. You want to run a 24/7 Server, then a dedicated server is the best way for you.

Dedicated Server Files are included and you can either start them from within your Beyond Enemy Lines 2 installation with the DedicatedServer.exe or the Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Dedicated Server Tool available in the Tools section or for download with SteamCMD. Dedicated Server files are currently only available for Windows.

Launching the DedicatedServer.exe will open this window:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/79a4a9b13187029633cfd740f7f35eacb08e3751.jpg

This window let you setup your server. By pressing "LAUNCH SERVER" your settings will be saved and the server will be started. Starting the DedicatedServer.exe will reload your last saved settings. Changing the gamemode will result in reseting the core options to the gamemode default settings. 

Server Stats:

 Default Tick Rate 60hz
 Default Port 7777


IMPORTANT: We had on some systems the issue that opening the Port 7777 was not enought to get the Server registrated on the Steam Master Server. A workaround would be to forward the entire Server.exe trough your firewall. Definitly not an ideal situation but a workaround. The Server.exe to forward is located in this folder:
...\Steam\steamapps\common\Beyond Enemy Lines 2\BeyondEnemyLines2\Binaries\Win64\BeyondEnemyLines2Server.exe


The Server Manager opens by clicking Server Manager in the Dedicated Server Launcher and will open up this window:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/18dc2ab328f385a9adf84b45b6ace57d9098bc7c.jpg
This window let you communicated with your gameserver and is until ingame RCON is fully implemented the only way to interact with your server except of shutting it down.

Update Player List
This will fill the list of players on the right sight of the window with checkboxes for each player.

Kick/Ban Player
All selected players in the Player List will be either kicked or banned.

End Match
Will end the current match and the server will switch to the next map.

Server Message
Will print a message with the sender Admin to the ingame text chat.

Warning: If you execute a new command before the last one was executed, you will overwrite the commands. You can not stack the commands.

Each time you press EXECUTE COMMAND, the tool will request the selected options from the server. As the Server is checking every 60 seconds for new commands, it could take up to 60 seconds until you see the result.

Anti-Cheat
VAC
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 utilizes VAC to detect cheats and hacks in the game as well as Gameban those players.

Anti-Memory Injection
All important variables are protected against Memory Injection and the game checks for memory injection tools and will crash once such a tool is running.

Server Sided Variables
All the important variables which are also projected against memory injection are running on the server. Weapon Handling is entire server sided and only result in actions visible to the server. Beyond Enemy Lines 2 does not deal damage on the client side and let the sever confirm this. Here the server gets a request to shoot a weapon from the client and the server checks the players current location, fires the weapon and broadcasts the result.

Global Ban List
On each Map change, every Server (Dedicated or P2P trough ingame hosting) will fetch a Polygon Art Ban list. This Ban List contains SteamIDs of players with a game ban. Once a Player joins a server, it's Steam ID gets validated. If invalid the player gets kicked instantly. With each update after the release, the then current ban list will be updated and hard coded in the game as a backup, if the online ban list was not successfully fetched.
Warning: Not only cheating and hacking will result in a game ban. Toxic, racist or other inappropriate behavior ingame or in this community can result in a game ban!

Active Admin + Local Ban List
Server Admins can activly kick and ban players from their server. Server Bans will result in a Local Ban List which works exactly like the Global Ban List but only for this server. This Local Ban List works for Dedicated and Player Hosted P2P Servers.

notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines 2 | Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/65e18ef5587925321f1f2611a9b26f64629712b4.jpg

Release Date
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-C_OpnAmWHE
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will launch 08.08.2019 on Steam featuring 2 Story Campaigns, 8 unique (13 in total) Multiplayer Maps across 3 Gamemodes.

Launch Price
Normal Price: $24.99
Launch Discount: -20%
Launch Price: $19.99*
*Or your regional equivalent.

As some of you might know from Beyond Enemy Lines 1, Polygon Art does not join the massive discount sales. This will be the best price you'll get for a long time!

Singleplayer

Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Campaign
Content: 7 Missions
Playtime: ~10h (on first run, depending on skill and playstyle)
Story: 
At 06:00 hours yesterday morning contact was lost with Abkhazia, an autonomous region south of the Greater Caucasus. Intercepted radio messages talk about heavy military activity. We still don’t know how it stands on the damages and the origin of the of the occupying forces are unknown.Intel is currently not able to provide any sitrep. All satellites in the region are offline and redirecting satelites will take a while. Until then we are blind. And this is where we are coming in: give us some eyes on the ground!


Warhead Campaign
Content: 1 Mission at Launch (7 additional following until December 2019 as DLC's)
Playtime: ~1h per Mission (on first run, depending on skill and playstyle)
Story:
This mission has top priority. Target: Mikhail Volkov. You are to locate him and bring him out for debriefing. Mikhail Volkov is our only link with the heist of the warhead. Mikhail is held at a military tank base. The whole area has excellent air defenced. We have to place you some distance from the target until those defenses are disabled. You will travel to the next goods yard - there you will resource transportation. The whole operation is simple - there are three stages:

1) Acquire transportation assets.
2) Disable air defences
3) Find Mikhail Volkov and safely extract him for debriefing.


Multiplayer
Conquest
A large-scale game mode with up to 32 players fighting for the control of key objectives. The team holding the most objectives is in the lead and will drain the enemies tickets. The team with the most tickets left at the end of a round wins. Kills and objective captures will reward you with money, which can be used to buy new weapons and equipment. There are no predefined classes!

Conquest will support Ground vehicles at launch only. Air vehicles are in development and are added as free post launch content.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/1077e47f85542460715abb24fbef2020188a8a20.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/5a632a5667162740279ef274c82534f8558e9ec6.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/337ec996a67b4250420762333fca2347cef30cff.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/f3098a1cc4a9b4202f0a2a122d3b2a80d8d02900.jpg
Bruma | Recruit Camp | Deep Forest | Trainyard

Team Deathmatch
This mode pits your side against the enemy and you need to defeat as many enemies as possible while protecting yourself and your team mates. Infantry based units combating each other to the death. Kill or be killed!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/3dbb606e4227368f6c1ad1211abe8464d75ba76d.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/ad31ee91067003073a1972949135149b698566b5.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/f3098a1cc4a9b4202f0a2a122d3b2a80d8d02900.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/b60cbb57b0ad0b6edcb0e3665506534d20b34493.jpg
Cargo | Construction Site | Trainyard | Harbor

Coop
Join up to 3 other friends or strangers to fight against the AI in specially designed missions.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/1077e47f85542460715abb24fbef2020188a8a20.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/5a632a5667162740279ef274c82534f8558e9ec6.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/337ec996a67b4250420762333fca2347cef30cff.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/f3098a1cc4a9b4202f0a2a122d3b2a80d8d02900.jpg
Bruma | Recruit Camp | Deep Forest | Trainyard

Coop Generator
Let the Random Coop Mission Generator generate a unique cooperative operation deep beyond enemy frontlines in a large, open world map.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/797475ad243d6b4189e14a88f7e9cab14fc1eb10.jpg
Valley

Free Content Updates
All future Multiplayer Updates (Maps, Gamemodes, Weapons) will be entirly free for everyone. There will never be be Lootboxes, Microtransactions or an Ingameshop!

Dedicated Server

Beyond Enemy Lines 2 supports Dedicated and Peer-To-Peer Servers, Dedicated Server Files are included within the game folder. You are free to set up your own server with your own rules.
It's your server - you dictate the rules!

Bot Support

All multiplayer game modes have full bot support!

notes.title: Multiplayer Details | Gamemodes, Maps, Servers and Monetization
notes.content:
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will feature a full Multiplayer part. So lets talk about Gamemodes, Maps, Servers and Monetization.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/69742d02706a6677ecb51c95fb0c03adfe24a302.jpg

Maps & Gamemodes
Right now there are 7 Maps in total available and playable across all gamemodes. The available amount of maps at launch is not set but at least 7 or more.

They split across the gamemodes as following:

 Conquest: 4 (4 unique)
 Team Deathmatch: 4 (3 unique)
 Coop:  4 (4 unique)

Conquest supports up to 32 Players and transport vehicles on large scale maps. Team Deathmatch on the other hand supports up to 16 Players and no vehicles on small and fast paced maps.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/dadf48d1114cb69503d286882415e1f1af9e1be1.jpg

Coop missions  for up to 4 Players are a different topic and can largly vary in scale and complexity. However the Coop Mission Generator will use a 'small' open world to create the missions which will be extended after the release with more areas, details and mission types.

Monetization
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 does not contain any Microtransactions, Lootboxes, Itemshops or anything else. You will have full access to the entire game once you bought it and all futher Multiplayer Updates like new Gamemodes and Maps will be entirly free for everyone who owns the game.

Along with most of the Multiplayer Updates, there will be a Singleplayer Paid DLC with a new ~1h long Story mission playing on the new Multiplayer map.

This is how the Multiplayer development should be keept alive. Without gambling or any other bullshit. You'll get content for free and are free to pai for even more Singleplayer content.

Server

 Peer-to-Peer and Dedicated Server
 Server files included within the Gamefolder or as a sperated tool (for Steam CMD)
 Tickrate 30hz (60hz possible in the future)
 Up to 32 Players
 Full Bot support (max 31 Bots)


Early Access
The Multiplayer will Launch as Early Access even if the game is not marked as Early Access. Why is this the case?

The reason behind is complex and yet so simple. Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is developed by Polygon Art, a single man developer (me). Releasing a 10h+ Singleplayer Campaign, PvP Multiplayer and Coop at the same time is a crazy task. And I put all my efforts in this game to deliver the best quality possible.

The Multiplayer is currently running very stable, crashes are not present and gamebreaking bugs are at this point fixed or just undiscovered. The closed Alpha is running constantly and the bug hunt was already very successfull.
How Multiplayer will behave in the end will only show the full live test and this is why it's launching as Early Access.

Singleplayer however will not be under Early Access status and be delivered in full release.
